remarks: Welcome to this stunning West Norwalk Colonial offering exceptional space, comfort, and versatility across four finished levels. Ideally located near the Merritt Parkway and I-95 connector, just minutes to downtown Norwalk with an easy commute to NYC.  This sun-filled home features an abundance of windows and natural light, cherry and oak hardwood floors throughout, expansive living and entertaining spaces, and exceptional storage. Highlights include an open and oversized family room, living room with wood-burning fireplace, and a gourmet kitchen equipped with high-end appliances, Thermador gas range, oversized island, wine cooler, and walk-in pantry.  The home offers three bedrooms all with en-suite baths, two bonus rooms - currently being used as a gym in finished attic and an office on upper level. The luxurious primary suite features vaulted ceilings, multiple closets, and a beautifully renovated bath. Lower level basement offers additional space for recreation, work, or storage.  Additional features include two-zone central heating and cooling, an oversized two-car garage with EV-ready outlet, a large driveway with ample parking, mudroom, extensive closet space, and two outdoor storage sheds.  Set on a private, level corner lot of over an acre, the property is enhanced by an automatic entry gate, patio, and built-in firepit-perfect for outdoor entertaining and enjoying a serene backyard setting.
